title: A colon at the margin after a block scalar key is the value of an empty outer key
notes: The input of edit/remove-block-key-before-a-margin-colon read as a value: the outer mapping has the key `c` and an empty (null) key whose value is 1; `c` holds a mapping with the key `a` plus a line feed and the value null.

provenance.reference: A reader that attached the margin colon to the block scalar key.
